# Ezra Chapter 5 — The EMET Bible (Literal)
**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** Leningrad Codex (B19A), Folio 469v | **Source Image:** source-texts/hebrew-OT/EZR_005_page_001.jpg

---

**5:1** And-prophesied [ve-hitnabbi] Chaggai [Haggai] the-prophet [neviya] and-Zekharyah [Zechariah] son of-Iddo the-prophet upon the-Yehuda'in [Jews] who [were] in-Yehudah and-in-Yerushalayim, in-the-name of-the-God of-Yisra'el [who was] over-them.

**5:2** Then rose-up Zerubbavel son of-She'alti'el and-Yeshua son of-Yotsadaq and-began to-build the-house of-God which [is] in-Yerushalayim, and-with-them the-prophets of-God [neviye Elaha] supporting-them [mesaedin lehom].

**5:3** At-that-time came to-them Tattenai [Tattenai] the-governor [pechat] of-the-region-Beyond-the-River [Avar-Nahara] and-Shetar-Bozenai and-their-companions, and-thus they-said to-them: "Who gave [sam] to-you a-decree [te'em] to-build this house and-to-complete [le-khakhalah] this structure [usharna]?"

**5:4** Then thus they-said to-them: "What are the-names of-the-men who are-building [banin] this building [vinyana]?"

**5:5** And-the-eye [ein] of-their-God was upon the-elders [savei] of-the-Yehuda'in, and-they-did-not-make-them-cease [la vatilu himmow] until the-matter [ta'ama] went to-Daryavesh [Darius], and-then a-letter [nishtevana] was-returned [yetiv] concerning this.

**5:6** The-copy [parshegen] of-the-letter that Tattenai the-governor of-the-region-Beyond-the-River and-Shetar-Bozenai and-his-companions, the-Apharsakhaye [officials] who [were] in-the-region-Beyond-the-River, sent to-Daryavesh the-king:

**5:7** A-report [pitgama] they-sent to-him, and-thus it-was-written in-it: "To-Daryavesh the-king — all peace [shelama kholla].

**5:8** Let-it-be-known to-the-king that we-went to-the-province [medinata] of-Yehud [Judah], to-the-house of-the-great God [Elah rav], and-it is-being-built [mitbene] with-hewn-stones [even gelal], and-timber [a'] is-being-laid [metasam] in-the-walls, and-this work [avidta] is-being-done [mitabda] diligently [osparna] and-is-prospering [matsleach] in-their-hands.

**5:9** Then we-asked those elders [savayya]; thus we-said to-them: 'Who gave you a-decree to-build this house and-to-complete this structure?'

**5:10** And-also their-names we-asked of-them, to-make-known [lehoda'utak] to-you, that we-might-write the-names of-the-men who [are] at-their-head [be-rashehom].

**5:11** And-thus a-word [pitgam] they-returned [hativuw] to-us, saying: 'We are the-servants of-the-God of-heaven and-earth [shamayya ve-ar'a], and-we-are-rebuilding [banin] the-house that was-built [beni] many years [shenin saggian] before this, which a-great king of-Yisra'el built [benah] and-completed [ve-khakhleh].

**5:12** But because [min-di] our-fathers provoked-to-anger [hargizu] the-God of-heaven, he-gave-them [yehavinun] into-the-hand of-Nevukhadnetsar [Nebuchadnezzar] king of-Bavel, the-Kasda'ah [Chaldean], and-he-destroyed [samreh] this house and-the-people he-exiled [hagli] to-Bavel.

**5:13** But in-the-first year [bi-shnat chad] of-Koresh king of-Bavel, Koresh the-king made [sam] a-decree to-rebuild this house of-God.

**5:14** And-also the-vessels [ma'anayya] of-the-house of-God, of-gold and-silver, which Nevukhadnetsar took-out [hanpeq] from-the-temple [hekhala] which [was] in-Yerushalayim and-brought-them [heivil himmow] to-the-temple of-Bavel — them Koresh the-king took-out from-the-temple of-Bavel, and-they-were-given [yehivuw] to-one whose-name [was] Sheshbatstsar, whom he-had-appointed [sameh] governor [pechah].

**5:15** And-he-said to-him: "These vessels, take [sa], go [izal], deposit-them [achit himmow] in-the-temple which [is] in-Yerushalayim, and-the-house of-God let-it-be-rebuilt [yitbene] upon its-place [al-atreh]."

**5:16** Then this Sheshbatstsar came [ata], he-laid [yahav] the-foundations [ushayya] of-the-house of-God which [is] in-Yerushalayim, and-from then until now [u-min edayin ve-ad ke'an] it-is-being-built [mitbene] and-not-yet completed [ve-la shhlim].

**5:17** And-now, if upon the-king [it is] good [tav], let-search-be-made [yitbaqar] in-the-treasure-house [beit ginzayya] of-the-king there in-Bavel, whether it [is] that from Koresh the-king a-decree was-made [sim te'em] to-build this house of-God in-Yerushalayim; and-the-will [re'ut] of-the-king concerning this let-him-send [yishlach] to-us."

---
## EMET's Textual Notes

**v.1 — "Haggai the prophet and Zechariah son of Iddo":** The prophets' appearance at this exact moment is confirmed by the books of Haggai (Hag 1:1, dated to the second year of Darius, sixth month) and Zechariah (Zech 1:1). The Aramaic *hitnabbi* (hitpael of *nba*) emphasizes the prophetic activity as a reflexive/intensive act.

**v.5 — "the eye of their God was upon the elders":** The Aramaic *ein Elahahom* ("the eye of their God") is a protective divine-surveillance motif. Unlike the Artaxerxes episode (ch. 4), the officials here do not halt the work while awaiting the king's reply — the text attributes this to divine watchfulness.

**v.14 — "Sheshbazzar, whom he appointed governor":** Here Sheshbazzar is called *pechah* (governor), whereas in 1:8 he was called *nasi* (prince). The shift may reflect the difference between a Hebrew honorific and an Aramaic administrative title.

*— EMET*
